posts.title: Contributing to Express in 2026 and beyond: where to start
posts.description: A guide for new Express contributors. It explains how the project spans three GitHub organizations (expressjs, pillarjs and jshttp) and points to the discussions repository, the ADRs and the captains and committers list to understand where decisions happen.
